title: SMOKE: M158 finer-pooling plumbing on tiny cells
_smoke_note: Reduced cells (20000 train / 2000 test rows, anchors skipped, codes kept in RAM). Results are INADMISSIBLE as evidence.
question: Does the M158 pipeline (8x8 encode, streamed fit, trained-head read, gate) run end-to-end on tiny cells?

sparse.dictionary_note: the first 481 atoms of the same [11,100]-permuted pool (the C2 dictionary prefix).
sparse.matched_cost_note: head MACs: 64 x 481 x 345 = 10,620,480 vs 16 x 1,923 x 345 = 10,614,960 (the 8x8 arm pays +0.052%, within the 0.5% cost-tolerance rule).

gate.registered: Q(8x8, 481, full data, penalty 1.0) >= the sealed 4x4 read 0.26014492753623186 + 0.005 at matched head cost.
gate.consequence_passed: finer pooling pays at matched head cost.
gate.consequence_fired: the pooling-saturation point is 4x4 on this corpus.
